question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        packaging_id as root_id,
        contains_id as current_id,
        qty as current_qty,
        1 as depth,
        qty as cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        pr.contains_id as current_id,
        pr.qty as current_qty,
        h.depth + 1,
        h.cumulative_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    p_root.id as root_id,
    p_root.name as container_name,
    p_curr.id as current_id,
    p_curr.name as item_name,
    SUM(h.cumulative_qty) as total_accumulated_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p_root ON h.root_id = p_root.id
JOIN packaging p_curr ON h.current_id = p_curr.id
GROUP BY p_root.id, p_root.name, p_curr.id, p_curr.name
HAVING SUM(h.cumulative_qty) > 500
ORDER BY p_root.id, p_curr.id
